Q1: Which pairs should the generalised `_conflict_prepare_guard_hook_template_merge` loop cover, now that `PAIRED_LIVE_COPIES` has five entries?
Choices:
A) All five current `PAIRED_LIVE_COPIES` pairs. The shell pair list stays equal to `PAIRED_LIVE_COPIES`, enforced by the parity contract test. Each pair goes through the same blob, mode and stage-shape checks; `session-start.sh` is an executable `.sh`, so its index mode is compared too. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Only the two pairs in the issue (`pr_merge_status_guard.py`, `prepush_affected_tests.py`). The parity test is dropped or relaxed to "shell list is a subset of `PAIRED_LIVE_COPIES`". Conflicts on the other three hooks keep failing closed with `sandbox_path_host_only`.
C) All pairs, read at runtime from the existing `review_untrusted_workspace.py paired-live-copies` subcommand (as the take-base block at line ~1028 already does) instead of a static shell list. The merge fails closed (no template merge) when that read fails.
